title: COVID-19 Swab Tests for VWO Staff Looking after Elderly
what_it_is: COVID-19 Swab Tests for VWO Staff Looking after Elderly

sections.label: COVID-19 testing for eldercare staff
sections.summary: Singapore phased surveillance testing of eldercare staff, completing about 10,500 residential care home staff swabs in May 2020, with one positive case.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: COVID-19 testing complements the existing precautionary measures in place for eldercare services, such as strict infection control, safe distancing and visitor restrictions.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: We have thus embarked on surveillance testing for staff of eldercare services to protect the seniors as they are more vulnerable to COVID-19 infection.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: This surveillance testing in eldercare services will be conducted in phases.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Given that seniors living in residential care homes are at higher risks, we prioritised and completed swab tests for about 10,500 staff of residential care homes in May 2020.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Test results for staff were all negative save for one staff member from Ren Ci Nursing Home @ Ang Mo Kio, which we have announced earlier.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: In June 2020, we will progressively test staff of other eldercare services in operation, including those working at day care centres.

sections.label: SAC readiness assessment requirements
sections.summary: SACs must undergo a readiness assessment and propose infection prevention, control and safe distancing plans before resuming on-site activities.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Before resuming on-site activities, SACs are required to undergo a readiness assessment and propose plans on infection prevention and control, and safe distancing measures.

sections.label: SACs opened as at 5 June
sections.summary: As at 5 June, 27 SACs have opened.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: As at 5 June, 27 SACs have opened.
